reconstruction.scope: Specific Metropolitan Museum of Art Fifth Avenue exterior: complete mapped irregular complex, three monumental recessed entrance arches and eight paired Corinthian columns, broad front stair, classical front wings/end pavilions, varied gallery roofs and rooflights, historic central core, rear polygonal Lehman wing, large sloping glazed Rockefeller and Dendur enclosures and American Wing court. Only the museum parent is replaced. Independent Central Park and Upper East Side buildings, streets and original terrain remain native. Existing photographic configuration; proposed Tang wing, temporary exhibitions/banners, copied inscriptions/artworks, furnished collection rooms and landscaping excluded.
